newsitem.title: USA: Kemper Strategic Income Fund raises payout.
newsitem.headline: Kemper Strategic Income Fund raises payout.

text.p: Kemper Strategic Income Fund said Thursday it expects to vote on June 30, 1997, a monthly dividend of $0.15 share, payable July 31, 1997, record July 15, 1997.
This rate would be an increase of $0.003 a share from the previous monthly dividend approved on May 30, 1997 and payable June 30, 1997 to shareholders of record on June 13, 1997.
This adjustment will better reflect the current earnings capability of the fund, Kemper said in a news release.
Kemper Strategic Income Fund is one of seven closed-end funds managed by Zurich Kemper Investments Inc.
